row.notes: Finds the component of type 0x146ca5978 in the element component vector (+0x30..+0x40) or allocates a new 0x48-byte one (vtable 0x145a71f80) and appends it; then allocates a 0x130-byte binding (vtable 0x14588e340) holding the path NeStr (+0xf8), id (+0xf4), two 16-byte callbacks (+0x108, +0x118), flag_a (+0x128) and flag_b (+0xf0), removes any existing binding with the same id and callbacks, pushes it to the component list (+0x20..+0x30), sets bit 3 of +0xe8 from bit3 and resolves it with Vm_Binding_SetSourceAndResolve / Vm_Binding_ResolveAndSubscribe. Returns the id. Good hook point to log which VM paths UI elements bind to.
